mapper.sql: select r.record_id, r.student_id, r.course_id, r.course_code, case when r.course_title is null or r.course_title = '' then c.title_zh else r.course_title end as course_title, r.term_id, r.grade, r.score, case when r.units is null or r.units = 0 then c.credits else r.units end as units, r.category, r.passed, r.record_status, r.source, t.term_code, t.term_name, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.update_by, r.update_time from edu_course_record r left join edu_course c on c.course_id = r.course_id left join edu_term t on t.term_id = r.term_id
mapper.select: where r.del_flag = '0' and r.student_id = #{studentId} order by t.term_code desc, r.record_id desc
select r.course_id from edu_course_record r where r.student_id = #{studentId} and r.passed = '1' and r.record_status = 'COMPLETED' and r.del_flag = '0' and r.course_id is not null
where r.del_flag = '0' and r.student_id = #{studentId} and r.passed = '1' and r.record_status = 'COMPLETED' order by t.term_code asc, r.record_id asc

select r.category as category, sum(case when r.units is null or r.units = 0 then coalesce(c.credits, 0) else r.units end) as units from edu_course_record r left join edu_course c on c.course_id = r.course_id where r.student_id = #{studentId} and r.passed = '1' and r.record_status = 'COMPLETED' and r.del_flag = '0' group by r.category order by r.category asc

select t.term_code as termCode, t.term_name as termName, r.grade as grade, r.score as score, case when r.units is null or r.units = 0 then coalesce(c.credits, 0) else r.units end as units from edu_course_record r left join edu_course c on c.course_id = r.course_id left join edu_term t on t.term_id = r.term_id where r.student_id = #{studentId} and r.passed = '1' and r.record_status = 'COMPLETED' and r.del_flag = '0' and t.term_code is not null order by t.term_code asc, r.record_id asc
mapper.insert: insert into edu_course_record ( student_id, course_id, course_code, course_title, term_id, grade, score, units, category, passed, record_status, source, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{studentId}, #{courseId}, #{courseCode}, #{courseTitle}, #{termId}, #{grade}, #{score}, #{units}, #{category}, #{passed}, #{recordStatus}, #{source}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
